blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Hali Long became the most capped Philippine football player after appearing in the Filipinas’ 5-1 loss to China on Monday in the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games women’s football match in Gifu, Japan. The Filipinas captain played her 109th international match during the close of the Asian Games group stage to break her tie with Azkals legend Phil Younghusband for most by a male or female member of the national squad. “Ten years in the making for this living legend! Thank you, Hali, for your continuous service to the nation.” the Philippine Football Federation said in a post commemorating Long’s landmark achievement. […]...
